Marta's told me the thing I didn't know I needed to hear. 400 sim—she lent Bram 400 sim for that seam, and she's carrying it quiet, same as me with the marker. The thing is, we both chose silence thinking it was kindness.

*meets her eyes*

I watch Marta go, the thing I was going to say still caught in my throat. The marker. The hand's width. I've already decided to let it go, but the words come out wrong when I try—like accusation, like I'm settling something I never meant to settle.

*looks toward the boundary one more time*

Nell will be there, sooner or later. Walking her own line. And we'll pass each other the way we always do, with the thing unsaid between us.

*turns to go*
